claim_limits: Classical CB/ESP/cardinality normalization and graph mixtures are attributed priors, not a generic novel method.
Unit fabricated QA is not a representative graph experiment or native/full-batch resource certificate.
Post-TEST successor development; no independent confirmatory claim using consumed official TEST.
No local conditional identity fit implies coherent graph posterior or served ranking benefit.

math.J_K: Uniform whole two-side conditional component mixture; one member identity couples sides
math.J_K_sep: Product of uniform whole-side conditional mixtures; matches all whole-side marginals at fixed parameters
math.W_K: Mean component conditional NLL, not the conditional analogue of frozen F_P
math.common_offset: Mathematically invariant to arbitrary member/side common shifts; finite precision qualifications use fixed tolerances and dyadic fixtures to avoid changing logits through rounding
math.conditional_nll: Per-member/side first-slot centering; complement likelihood avoids two large total-logit subtractions
math.conditioning_old_J_P_mixture: Requires count-evidence posterior component weights; not the uniformly mixed J_K implemented here
math.extreme_count_loss_and_gradient: Exact graph-connected zero for k0,kn and empty; never sum large finite logits merely to multiply by zero
math.grouped_float_ordering: Exact real-arithmetic law; floating reductions/gather order differ from v1 and remain subject to the unchanged fixed CPU tolerances and future native float32 assurance.
math.normalizer: Finite reachable-state logaddexp elementary symmetric recurrence; complement uses min(k,n-k)
math.ragged_batch_strategy: Exact per-side(n,min(k,n-k)) groups. Reachable ESP cells vectorized across member/query/count axes; no Python query loop in batch CB loss. r0 skips auxiliary normalizer only; r1/complement uses exact categorical logsumexp.

numerical_precision_limit: Log-space prevents exponential overflow; arbitrary finite float32 summation/cancellation can still overflow/round. No universal exact floating-point/large-support guarantee.

reduction.existing_positive_negative_query_reducti: Preserve mean_positive_aux + mean_negative_aux beside native target BCE in a future separately admitted integration
reduction.query_average: All queries retained, including empty and extreme counts

serving.native_completion_and_target_BCE: Unchanged/count-free; auxiliary scores are not served link probabilities

single_control.batched_teacher_forcing: All past-only prefix/count/progress features assembled through integer exclusive segmented cumsums and support-length-grouped local floating cumsums; one unchanged MLP call evaluates every real slot, including forced choices, with one zero-row call for all-empty geometry.
single_control.capability_oracle: Manually assigned engineering head represents matching-side n2/k1 shared-mixture law using earlier selected identity, with analytic parameter derivative
single_control.endpoint_exchange: No auxiliary orientation averaging or automatic symmetrization; convention disclosed, not endpoint-invariant by claim
single_control.endpoint_range: Negative and >=len(h) endpoints rejected before indexing; valid visible feature semantics preserved with tensor CSR/segment-start gather and subject to exact successor QA.
single_control.extreme_count_gradient: All forced choices, exact zero head gradients; original native neural schedule still required
single_control.family: Attributed contextual fixed-count autoregressive single, auxiliary only
single_control.float32_ragged_assurance: Supplemental source only; not executed and not full native integration.
single_control.floating_cumulative_scope: No floating global cumulative subtraction across queries; sum/GEMM/reduction order changes from sequential source and uses the existing working dtype/tolerances. No bitwise or universal finite-precision claim.
single_control.head: Linear523->64, ReLU, Linear64->1; no dropout/norm/sigmoid clipping
single_control.head_evaluations: Every slot row evaluated by Linear523->64/ReLU/Linear64->1 once in one batch. Forced rows cannot be skipped. Parameter/head/initialization family unchanged.
single_control.initialization: Explicit PyTorch nn.Linear default Kaiming uniform(a=sqrt5) and fan-in uniform biases; constructed after one fresh native encoder/decoder under a separately frozen initialization state. No trained state donor.
single_control.native_backbone: One native width64 encoder/recursive unary predictor, separate future binding; no prediction ensemble
single_control.normalized_law: Teacher-forced product of logistic choices, forced only if remaining count is0 or equals unseen slots
single_control.order: Original query endpoint orientation; ascending unique native CSR candidate ID within query/side; all left slots before right
single_control.prefix_features: Per-side mean previously selected candidate h64;128 total; no current/future teacher bit identity
single_control.visible_unary_shift_invariance: Per-query/side first-slot centering is label-free; only auxiliary feature changes, native target logits/completion unchanged

teacher.counts: derived internally from detached teacher bits
teacher.source: complete TRAIN observational incidence under preserved native mask
teacher.zero_label: unobserved in TRAIN; not verified latent absence
